about_the_game:
Step into the world of Earth of Oryn with this free demo. Build, manage, and lead your people as you try out the first chapters of the game.

What You’ll Play

  • Two missions as the Brandford civilization:

    • Tutorial Mission – learn the basics of building, gathering, combat and keeping your citizens safe and fed.

    • First Mission – put your new skills to the test as you expand your settlement and face new challenges.

  • Experience the game’s unique art style.

  • Try out early city-building tools: resource gathering, zoning, construction, and citizen management.

  • Early access to core systems: citizen needs, building placement, weather, and terrain elevation.

  • Save progress.

  • Atmospheric original soundtrack.

What’s Not Included

  • Other civilizations (only Brandford is available here).

  • Later campaign missions, advanced technologies, or larger-scale combat.

  • Does not include advanced buildings, diplomacy, creative mode, or large-scale battles.

  • Creative (full sandbox) and campaign mode (exploration).

Playtime

Expect around 1–2 hours of gameplay, depending on your style.

Ready for More?

If you enjoy the demo, add Earth of Oryn to your wishlist to be notified at release and unlock more content.

Team

Earth of Oryn is developed by a solo indie developer, who has poured years of work into bringing this world to life. Your feedback and support mean the world in shaping the journey ahead.

Thanks for playing and helping me shaping Earth of Oryn!

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
